about: Samples for scoring heading levels of docling-parts 2 against PDF outlines (issue 516). Both are unique primary Kudos PDFs (KUDOS listing of 21 Oct 2026) with Docling output in the 11 Nov Kudos Docling export, at most 150 pages (done.json); candidates sorted by sha256, shuffled with Python random.Random(seed), the first N with at most 150 pages kept. dev (seed 516, 299): the rules were tuned on it; it excludes the 39 sha256s of documents.json and documents-run2.json. heldout (seed 517, 600): drawn and fetched before it was scored, scored once after the rules were frozen; it excludes those 39 and the 299 dev files.
